_about: Public-domain Alban Butler (1710-1773, English Catholic priest and hagiographer) for the Word Hoard: The Lives of the Fathers, Martyrs, and other Principal Saints in twelve volumes, eleven from the Derby edition for the Catholic Book Society (1842-1846) and vol. 8 from the Dublin second edition (1780), with The Moveable Feasts (1774) and the Meditations and Discourses (1840), from Internet Archive scans. Written in English. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 26 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

_alternates.butler-lives-first-edition: The first edition (London, 1756-1759, 4 vols): its title pages name no author
_alternates.butler-lives-other-sets: The London John Murphy stereotype set (about 1812-1815; better OCR, but the author's name is not legible on its engraved title pages), Edinburgh 1798-1800, Derby 1842-1846 (vol. 8 has no text), and partial Dublin, New York and Baltimore sets
_alternates.butler-lives-dublin-1779: The complete twelve-volume Dublin second edition (1779-1780), the first to name him: long-s OCR, and four volumes' title pages are not legible; its vol. 8 is on the shelf
_alternates.butler-life-tobie-matthews: The Life of Sir Tobie Matthews (London: J. P. Coghlan, 1795): his name is not legible in the OCR
